tools.name: book_a_demo
tools.description: Get the link to book a ShortPoint demo. Returns the schedule-demo URL to navigate to.

tools.name: browse_templates
tools.description: Open the ShortPoint SharePoint template gallery to browse templates, optionally pre-filling a search term. Once the gallery is open, the search_templates tool becomes available there to filter and return matching templates.

query.description: Optional search term to pre-fill in the gallery

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the link to ShortPoint pricing and plans. Returns the pricing page URL to navigate to.

tools.name: request_a_quote
tools.description: Get the link to request a ShortPoint pricing quote. Returns the quote request URL to navigate to.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Get a link to search ShortPoint help and documentation for a query. Returns a help-center search URL to navigate to.

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Get the link to start a free ShortPoint trial. Returns the trial sign-up URL to navigate to.
